description:
`issue search --label` rejects namespace wildcards such as `type:*`, while `query --label` accepts the same pattern. Label filtering has two contracts depending on the command, so agents cannot reuse a pattern across them.

## Background

`jit query --label` matches through `labels::matches_pattern` (`crates/jit/src/labels.rs:183`), which supports exact labels and `namespace:*` wildcards; its help states this. `jit issue search --label` validates each filter as a concrete label at `crates/jit/src/main.rs:3167` and rejects `type:*` with `invalid --label filter 'type:*'`. If that validation were bypassed, `search_issues_with_filters` would still match nothing, because it compares by exact string equality (`crates/jit/src/commands/search.rs:66-68`). The search help documents the filter as `namespace:value` only.

Reproduction with one `type:task` and one `type:epic` issue:

```bash
jit query all --label 'type:*' --json        # count 2
jit issue search --label 'type:*' --json     # Error: invalid --label filter 'type:*'
jit issue search --label 'type:task' --json  # count 1
```

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `issue search --label namespace:*` returns every issue that carries any label in that namespace and that satisfies the text query and other filters.
- [hard] REQ-02: `issue search --label` and `query --label` accept the same patterns and return the same issue set for the same pattern when no other filter is given.
- [hard] REQ-03: Search label filtering uses the shared label-pattern matcher; `search_issues_with_filters` contains no separate exact-match comparison.
- [hard] REQ-04: A malformed pattern such as `type` or `:*` still fails with an invalid-argument error.
- [hard] REQ-05: `issue search --help` describes the `--label` argument as accepting exact labels and `namespace:*` wildcards.
- [hard] REQ-06: A regression test proves a `namespace:*` search label filter matches issues in that namespace and excludes issues outside it.

## Notes

`query` applies label filters through `domain::queries::query_by_labels`; search can apply the same predicate rather than re-validating labels its own way.
title: Accept namespace wildcards in issue search label filters
